lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [mischievous] So, obviously... I did the responsible thing.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [fast, giddy] A gold hoverboard. Gold sneakers. A gold toothbrush — which tastes terrible, by the way.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: A limo with a ball pit. A robot butler named Jeeves Three Thousand.

lines.speaker: BUTLER
lines.text: [robotic, polite, British] Your golden cereal is served, sir.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [proud] And a mansion... with an OBBY in the backyard.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [giddy, faster] A solid gold statue of myself. Four hundred pizzas. I paid a guy to stand in line for me. [pause] Then I paid another guy to stand in line for HIM.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [laughing] And suddenly... I had a LOT of friends.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: Kids I'd never met. Kids from other schools. One guy who said he was my cousin from Brazil.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [laughing] They laughed at all my jokes. Even the bad ones. [pause] ESPECIALLY the bad ones.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [guilty, slower] Pickle came too. [pause] But my butler had a VIP list.

lines.speaker: BUTLER
lines.text: [robotic, cold] Twelve Robux is below the minimum, sir.

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.text: [small, sad] Oh. [pause] That's okay. I'll just... wait out here.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [quiet, regretful] I should have gone outside. [pause] I didn't.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [uneasy] And every time I bought something... the Thirty Percent Guy got a little... bigger.

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [voice a bit deeper] Marketplace fee! [burps] Thirty percent!
